citation.title: Outlier-robust Kalman Filtering through Generalised Bayes
citation.authors: Duran-Martin, G.; Altamirano, M.; Shestopaloff, A. Y.; Sanchez-Betancourt, L.; Knoblauch, J.; Jones, M.; Briol, F.-X.; Murphy, K.
citation.venue: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (PMLR)

topic: Generalised-Bayes weighted-likelihood Kalman/EKF/EnKF updates that down-weight outlying measurements
own_question: Can closed-form filters stay robust to measurement outliers at KF-like cost?
actual_method_and_evidence: The method scales the log-likelihood by a weight computed from the observation-prediction residual, using IMQ, Mahalanobis, or thresholded weights. For linear and EKF updates, the authors prove a bounded KL posterior influence function under stated conditions on the weight. Experiments are synthetic 2D tracking, corrupted UCI MLP regression, and Lorenz96 EnKF. No fusion-plasma or CES data are used.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Generalised-Bayes residual weighting is one documented way to make Kalman-type updates robust to outlying measurements while keeping closed-form updates.
claim_checks.qualification: The proof covers linear and linearised Gaussian models. Robustness holds only for measurement outliers, not state outliers, and assumes known R_t and Q_t.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The source contains no CES, BES, or ECEI data and no report-arrival timing.
validation_if_relevant: Hyperparameters were tuned by Bayesian optimisation on the first trial and evaluated on the remaining trials. All data are synthetic or corrupted benchmarks.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply our estimators use WoLF.
Do not imply any plasma diagnostic validation.
Do not transfer the reported speed or accuracy results to our study.
Do not cite this paper as evidence about CES outlier rates.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Cite only if the theory section discusses robustness to outlying CES reports in a Kalman-style baseline. Otherwise omit.
